title: བསྟན་འགྱུར། སྡེ་དགེ། ཚད་མ། ཡེ (Derge Tengyur, vol. 193)
shelf_note: A Pramāṇa-section commentary passage on jāti (futile rejoinders: utkarṣa/apakarṣa/varṇya/avarṇya-sama), exactly what the Tshad ma volume of the Derge Tengyur holds.

ocr_errors.problem: 'སྒྲ' (sound) dropped from the avarṇyasama example; sense still recoverable from context

tr_errors_A.english: It likely follows Dignāga or Dharmakīrti’s systems
tr_errors_A.problem: speculative attribution in the meta, not on the page

tr_errors_B.english: just as the clay pot is already established and not something to be proved
tr_errors_B.problem: 'already established' interpolated into the quoted rejoinder
Tibetan says 'another property'; 'intrinsic' is an added characterisation

tr_errors_B.english: adds an extraneous attribute of the example

pages.prefer_reason: Both are faithful with no serious errors, but A renders the apakarṣa and avarṇya definitions literally while B adds 'intrinsic' and 'already established' that are not in the Tibetan.

book_verdict: Correct leaf (printed folio 612), clean woodblock transcription with only small slips, and two sound translations of a jāti passage; A is slightly more literal than B.
